value.author: pi-agent
value.text: CodeQL js/polynomial-redos alert #18 on the brace-union regex introduced by this PR: the leftmost-union exec() backtracks polynomially, and measurements confirm it (adversarial '{{,' + 50k commas takes ~19.4 s; the 200k variant exceeds 100 s). Plan: replace the regex with a single-pass indexOf/char scanner that keeps the exact leftmost expandable-union semantics (nested and non-comma braces untouched, same left-to-right expansion order), bound expansion at 1024 alternatives with a clear refusal error so hostile configured globs cannot explode memory, document the limit in the docstring and README, add adversarial timing, expansion-limit and semantics tests, and record a behavioural revert proof.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Revert proof (behavioural): with only expandGlobUnions restored to the flagged regex body, the new tests fail exactly as required — the adversarial timing test takes 20.6 s (50 ms bound; the 200k-comma variant exceeds 100 s) and the expansion-refusal test fails because the unbounded regex silently expands past 1024 alternatives. With the linear scanner restored, the same suite passes: the '{{,' + 50k-commas input expands in ~0.2 ms and the closing-brace variant refuses in ~0.3 ms. Semantics were also differentially verified: the scanner and the old regex produce identical expansions for 400,000 random patterns (including nested, non-comma, empty-alternative and negative-alternative braces).

value.text: CodeRabbit round 3 (PR 163, head 222b469): three findings verified against the code. (1) duplication scan roots: valid — the analyzer passes only the repository root plus --pattern to jscpd, while the source discovery accepts scopes outside the root; a real out-of-root probe made jscpd report zero sources and the completeness check reject the scan. (2) coverage-gate inventory: valid — the independent inventory uses fs.globSync which skips dot entries, while the gate's collector reads directories directly and keeps hidden .ts files.
